bio.text: Nathaniel Moran earned a B.A., an MBA and a law degree at Texas Tech University after attending the U.S. Military Academy at West Point for two years.
He practiced business and commercial law in Tyler, Texas, and served on the Tyler City Council from 2005 to 2009.
Moran was appointed Smith County Judge in 2016, was elected to a full term in 2018, and was elected to Congress in November 2022.
